personal_info.name: Spoorthi
personal_info.bio: Computer Science (Cybersecurity) student with knowledge of Python, operating systems, networking, and cybersecurity tools. Hands-on experience in technical investigation, problem-solving, software testing, and full-stack development, seeking to apply skills in IT infrastructure, cloud support, and security operations.

education.details: Focus on cryptographic primitives, secure network engineering, OS security fundamentals, application threat detection, and software auditing.
Karnataka Board coursework in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology.
Foundational sciences, mathematics, humanities, and communication skills.

experience.company: MAHE-ISAC Centre of Excellence for Cybersecurity
details: Contributed to cybersecurity projects involving cyber-physical infrastructure risk analysis (CascadeShield) and behavioral authentication for insider-threat detection (Cyber DNA).
Used Python and technical tools to analyze system behavior, evaluate results, and support technical investigation and problem-solving.

Gained hands-on experience in web application security testing, Active Directory fundamentals, OSINT, and digital forensics using 8+ security tools including Maltego, Burp Suite, BloodHound, Metasploit, and Shodan.
Investigated OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities during a capstone CTF and documented findings in a structured penetration testing report.

projects.name: QRIntel
projects.tagline: Explainable Threat Intelligence Platform for Malicious QR Infrastructure
projects.publication: Published on IEEE Xplore (https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11746844); accepted at ICOSICS 2026
projects.description: Multi-modal threat detection platform identifying malicious QR-linked URLs through lexical, DNS, redirect, SSL, and headless Selenium visual/DOM analysis with deterministic JSON audit logs for SOC analysts.

projects.name: Cyber DNA
projects.tagline: Continuous Behavioral Authentication for Insider-Threat Detection
projects.description: Behavioral authentication framework evaluated on the CMU CERT r4.2 dataset using behavioral drift metrics, Quantum-Inspired Evolutionary Algorithm (QEA) feature selection, Optuna-tuned XGBoost, SHAP explainability, and Mamdani Fuzzy risk tiering.

projects.name: CascadeShield
projects.description: Hybrid Graph Neural Network (GNN) and SimPy SEIR epidemiological model analyzing cascading attacks across interconnected smart-city infrastructure networks, with a FastAPI backend and React SCADA visualizer.

projects.name: AgileGraph
projects.tagline: Graph-Learned Crypto-Agility Risk Scoring for Post-Quantum Migration
projects.description: Automated cryptographic discovery across Python, Java, Go, and manifests, 6-node property graphs, 7-factor heuristic risk scoring with Mosca's theorem PQC urgency triage, and a Heterogeneous GATv2 model backed by FastAPI and React + TypeScript.
